title: Disco and requests
summary: He plays disco and Latin on request but prefers his own music.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: some of the newer developments in music, specifically disco, and the electronic instruments and things of that nature, in comparison to the type of dance music that you did with your band, the big band?

Well, I never did get into it. I haven't talked against it. That's one thing. I just, I have one or two tunes in the book that, the younger group comes up and likes to have a disco number, I won't turn them away. I've got a young drummer there. He's been with me since he was 19. He knows how to play rock. You know, he'd do the disco. So, I'd take the standard tune and put the new tempo and go along with them so they can have their fun. You know? But, I don't, for myself, I'd rather play the music that I'm used to doing. But, I can do that, you know. We can do that, but we don't have to do too much of that. Now, they have two other bands that play that if they need it, besides the records that they do. But, I don't have no problem there.
Sometimes, I get some people my age, oh.
Okay. You were saying something about the people your age wanting a disco number?

Oh yeah. I get requests off and on for that. So, trying to satisfy them, I'll go and play it for them. And then, the floor may not be full, but they have fun. A lot of people, I don't lose nobody. So, I'm glad to see that, too, you know. So, I try to play, like the cha-cha. I do that Latin music. I do a variety here. So, you have to because you get everybody who would like to have this number. So, I'll give anything that they ask. I play a variety of it.
